fields.description: Program Description Note: Tuition fee for the first year is RMB 15,000, for second to sixth year is RMB 25,000/year. (1) Program Introduction GMU Clinical Medicine program, established in 1938, is the earliest founded core major in school with most solid foundation and strongest advantage. The program is recognized by WCAME, WHO, ECFMG, CMC. (2) Study Duration: 6 years Including one year internship. (3) Tuition fee: Calculated in RMB
fields.fees: Fee Structure Tuition Fee Bachelor RMB 25,000 per year RMB 150,000 in total (About $ 20,951) Accommodation Fee International Students' Apartment Double Room RMB 4,000 (More Details) Single Room RMB 8,000 (More Details) Other Fees Service Fee USD 200 Living Expense(Per Month) RMB 1,600 to RMB 2,050
fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. One photocopy of your passport valid for at least 6 months after entry. Applicants applying from China are required to provide a photocopy of the visa page or residence permit page, and the most recent entry stamp record. * 3. English proficiency test certificate * 4. Senior high school diploma(or certificate equivalent). Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 5. Official Transcripts of your senior high school or previous academic stage(including all courses taken). You are required to provide the notarized translation if the documents are in languages other than Chinese or English. * 6. Bank statements cover the record for at least the last six months. * 7. Original photocopy of FOREIGNER PHYSICAL EXAMINATION FORM Applicants can download the form from the website of our school and then go to the designated hospital in your host country for physical examination. The results are valid for 6 months. * 8. Financial Guarantee Statement Financial supporter has to be the same one holding the bank account, mentioned in financial statement page. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. A copy of the valid ID card or passport photo page of the guarantor. * 10. Resume You can download a template or sample from here . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 18 to 25 years old. Senior high school diploma or equivalent for university application. Overall score ≥ 70% (total 100%). Biology, Chemistry and Math: over 70%. English (for students who are from non-English-speaking countries/regions): IELTS overall score≥6.0 or TOEFL overall score≥80. Pakistan HSSC transcript（pre-medical group）overall score ≥ 750/1100 or 800/1200.
